You should get mostly everything with the free but the premium keeps specific data (breathing rate, temperature) for more than a week.
You still get the information in the free

Within the health metrics section (breathing rate, temperature, resting heart rate, oxygen), the information is stored for one week. The only difference with the premium is that it is stored for more than a week
